Name: Jen's Improved Starter Farmhouse
Author: jenf1
Description:
[size=4][b]This mod is only available here at Nexus Mods! If you see it anywhere else, it has been uploaded without my permission and should be taken down immediately![/b][/size]

The starter farmhouse, but with a bit of extra space for whatever you'd like! Kitchen can be configured on or off.

- The pillar separating the main part and the new section can have wall items placed upon it.
- Wall and floor in the added area can be changed.

[size=5]Config Options:[/size]

Install the mod and run the game using SMAPI at least once in order to generate a config.json file.

- [b]Enable Mod[/b] (True, False) Defaults True
- [b]Add Kitchen[/b]: Adds a functioning kitchen to the added section of the farmhouse. (True, False) Defaults True

[size=5]Install:[/size]

- Download and install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url].
- Copy [CP] Jen's Improved Starter Farmhouse into your Stardew Valley/Mods folder
- Load the game using SMAPI and enjoy!
